# ProCodrr

> ProCodrr is an online learning platform for programming and web development. It offers video courses organised into sections and lectures, with lesson discussions, notes and progress tracking for enrolled learners.

Course catalogue and course overview pages are public. Lesson playback, discussions and learner dashboards require an account.

## Public pages

- [Home](/): Popular, free and recently added courses, plus popular learner discussions.
- [Courses](/courses): The full course catalogue with titles, section and lecture counts, duration and price.

## Accounts

- [Log in](/login): Sign in to an existing account.
- [Register](/register): Create a learner account.

## Notes for automated agents

- Each course has a public overview page at `/courses/{course-slug}/overview`, linked from the catalogue.
- Lesson pages live under `/learn/{course-slug}/{lecture}` and need an enrolled, signed-in learner for full content.
- Pages are rendered in the browser on top of prerendered HTML; the prerendered HTML of the public pages already contains their main content.
